# Purpose
This generated header defines metric metadata for the `resolf` area of the codebase. It declares counter names, offsets, types, descriptions, and converter settings for events such as bank drops, stash operations, address lookup table resolution, expired blockhash failures, bundle peer failures, and database races. The file also defines the total number of `resolf` metrics and exposes the `FD_METRICS_RESOLF` metadata table for use by other parts of the program. Because the file is generated by `gen_metrics.py`, it serves as a fixed interface for metric registration and must not be edited by hand.
